name: Rebasol
description: Rebasol is a comprehensive neurochemical restoration compound designed for patients emerging from prolonged polysubstance dependency, chronic stimulant use, or SNT-interface drug abuse. It delivers a calibrated combination of dopamine precursors, serotonin synthesis cofactors, GABA stabilizers, and glutamate normalization agents over a sustained 16-hour release cycle, gradually restoring neurotransmitter production and receptor density toward pre-dependency baselines. Full courses run 6-12 weeks and are typically paired with behavioral therapy.
effects: Gradual restoration of natural neurotransmitter production capacity
Receptor density normalization across dopamine, serotonin, and GABA systems
Reduction of post-acute withdrawal syndrome (PAWS) duration
Stabilized sleep architecture and appetite regulation
Progressive improvement in cognitive clarity and emotional stability
side_effects: First two weeks: emotional volatility as systems recalibrate — mood swings, unpredictable crying, irritability
Vivid dreams, sometimes disturbing, during serotonin restoration phase
Skin irritation at patch site; some users develop contact dermatitis with extended use
Rare: overcorrection syndrome — rebound hyperemotionality and anxiety if discontinued abruptly
Minor interactions with chrome augmentation cooling systems — patch must be placed away from subdermal hardware
duration: 16 hours per patch; full course 6-12 weeks
cultural_context: Rebasol is what recovery actually looks like for most of GLMZ's working population — unglamorous, slow, and uncomfortable. The phrase 'wearing the Floor' refers to someone in serious long-term recovery; it's said with respect in some circles and with pity in others. Tier 3 recovery houses run Rebasol programs as standard aftercare. The emotional volatility of the first two weeks is known as 'the Flood' — the period where everything you numbed comes back at once. Some users describe week three as the first time they've felt genuinely human in years.
story_hooks: A fixer hired for a high-stakes job is three weeks into a Rebasol course — at peak emotional volatility — and has to maintain composure during negotiations where any visible instability means death

Counterfeit Rebasol patches have appeared in Tier 2 recovery houses; they contain the packaging chemistry but none of the active compounds, leaving residents cycling through withdrawal without realizing the treatment isn't working

A researcher at Novafold has discovered that Rebasol's serotonin synthesis pathway inadvertently interacts with a specific class of military-grade chrome — creating a brief window of extraordinary emotional empathy and perceptual openness that certain Spire interests want to weaponize
